title: Serving Horizon Huddle — Sept 15 2027
content:
Snapshot: quick read for org-wide sync (ongoing experiments + decisions to align on).

Attendees: Ethan (notes), Priya, Marina, Jonah, Aisha, ripple of ~40 watchers from platform, obs, product.

Agenda:
- Quick health + metrics (2 min)
- Incidents / oncall recap (5 min)
- Experiments update (KV cache, batching) (8 min)
- Rollout coordination (quantized variants + dedicated fallback) (8 min)
- Breakouts + action items (10 min)

Highlights / Health:
- P50 generation latency: 82ms (global, small-text workloads). P95: 310ms — improvement in EU region after kernel upgrade.
- Aggregate tokens/s: 1.2M sustained across hosted clusters during peak.
- Cost/1M tokens (hosted blended): ~$5.80 (down ~9% month-over-month attributable to smart batching changes).
- Error rate (5xx) last 7d: 0.16% (spikes correlated with one fishy node pool in us-west-2 on 9/12).

Oncall / Incidents:
- 9/12 partial degraded responses in us-west-2: root cause = NVidia driver patch + driver mismatch during autoscaler restart. Action: pin driver image w/ canary, ops ticket RED-3789.
- Postmortem planned: https://linear.app/RED/issue/INF-4008-postmortem-us-west-driver
- Small user-facing rollout rollback on 9/10 (quantized-8bit): quality regression on one LLM family. Decision: pause rollout, run targeted evals for 3 prompt suites.

Experiments update:
1) KV cache eviction policy (INF-4023)
   - Hypothesis: TTL-based eviction improves P95 for multi-turn chat at cost of slight mem increase.
   - Running A/B across 20% of traffic; initial signals: p95 down ~12% for chat agents with long contexts. Memory footprint +6% on inference nodes.
   - Open question: circuit-breaker threshold when mem > 85% (ops proposal: add soft-eviction at 80%). Owner: Priya. Due: 2027-09-22.

2) Continuous batching adjustments
   - Adjusted backlog threshold for small payloads to 40ms (was 25ms) to reduce cold-start overhead. Observed throughput +4% and P50 +2ms higher. Need to verify tail impact for latency-SLO routes. Owner: Jonah. Data in PR: runtime/pull/889.

3) Quantization profile sweep (dedicated + hosted)
   - Running quantization candidates on nightly harness. One candidate causes tokenization drift on multilingual prompts (detected by eval harness). We paused canary. Action: add tokenization-debug logging for candidate builds. Owner: Marina. ETA: 9/20.

Rollout and routing coordination:
- Canary plan for q8 variants: hold off until eval pass on 9/20. If pass, canary to 5% traffic with immediate fallback policy to float16 model.
- Dedicated overflow routing: new policy to send excess requests to regional capacity instead of global fallback; prototype working but needs SRE signoff (RED-3911).
- Cross-team dependency: Product wants early access to q8 for conversational summary feature next sprint. Need explicit SLA on quality regression window. Owner: Aisha (eng-product liaison). Due: 9/19.

Observability / Dashboards:
- Request: add KV cache hit-rate per-customer to per-route dashboards. Rationale: helps correlate cost/regression for customers using long-context agents. Ticket: OBS-2245.
- Tracing: add sampled traces for fallback events; currently hard to debug when fallback triggers silently. Owner: Observability (Marina to coordinate).

Breakout notes (3 concurrent groups):
- Group A (runtime kernels): plan to advertise kernel selection metrics (which kernel chosen per-model/seq-len) in nightly CI artifacts. Next step: small exporter to S3. Owner: Jonah.
- Group B (ops + infra): driver image pinning + canary strategy. Proposed: rolling-driver-canary in non-prod pool for 48hrs. Owner: Priya.
- Group C (product + eval): expand prompt-suite coverage for q8 candidates to include non-English legal phrases. Owner: Aisha + Marina.

Decisions made (consensus):
- Pause q8 global canary until targeted evals complete (quality-first).
- Deploy KV eviction soft-threshold at 80% mem usage as short-term mitigation; revisit after two weeks of telemetry.
- Run driver-image canary for 48hrs in staging prior to any cluster-wide driver updates.

Action items (owner / due):
- Priya: implement soft-eviction + dashboard alert for mem>80% (due 2027-09-22).
- Marina: add tokenization-debug logs for quantization candidates; run expanded evals with legal prompts (due 2027-09-20).
- Jonah: complete backlog-threshold A/B analysis and surface tail-latency per-route (due 2027-09-23).
- Aisha: coordinate product SLA ask for q8 early access and draft contingency language (due 2027-09-19).
- Ops (TBD): roll driver-canary in staging (start 9/17). Note: assign RED-3789 follow-up.

Risks / open questions:
- Memory growth from KV change could trigger OOMs on older instance types; need to validate on t4-like small nodes.
- If q8 introduces subtle tokenization drift across language families, rollback cost may be non-trivial for customers relying on deterministic outputs.
- Autoscaler restart timing is still brittle on heavy-burst scenarios; consider staggered drain windows.

Notes to self / roughs:
- Quick experiment idea: adaptive TTL per customer by recent-turns metric (cheap heuristic). Put on backlog INF-4050.
- Check if we can export kernel-selection data into the existing per-route trace (avoid new storage).

Appendix: quick links and snippets
- INF-4023 KV eviction A/B results (internal csv): s3://redwood-data/kv-evict/ab-results-20270915.csv
- Driver incident timeline (notes): https://linear.app/RED/issue/INF-4008-postmortem-us-west-driver
- Runtime PR for batching knob: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/889

Next sync: weekly serving sync — Thurs 9/22 11:00 PT (agenda will be targeted update on KV eviction + canary status).

End of notes.

(rough draft: expect edits — comments welcome, esp. from SRE + obs on alert thresholds)
